rows.label: Send five of the line
rows.message:
The Squadron for Santo Domingo — Send five of the line: 500 gold (the treasury holds 10,399); 1 administrative action (1 left today); five of the line sail (45 → 40 in port until Early July 1807) — 36 in 100 they come home whole; caught, the five are lost and the men are ashore.
Decrès: the squadron slips out of Brest on the night tide.
